description:
Kwon Yeong has been rejected by Yun Jeyeong six times, each dismissal wrapped in gibberish that he can't make out. But the real problem isn't just the heartbreak; it's that every time he's rejected, he's transported back to the first day of the new semester when he first met Jeyeong. Stuck in this endless cycle, Yeong's confessions always take him back to square one. Frustrated and fed up, Yeong declares, ""I'm not gonna like you anymore! Never again!"" Just when Yeong decides to give up, the loop restarts. But this time, something begins to change in their relationship. 

Dive into the mysterious and heartwarming journey of ""Love on a Loop,"" where every reset brings new possibilities for love and self-discovery.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prolouge and two side story chapters.*
